english.note: Use this as the all-purpose term for the person or company responsible for building or improving a structure.
Use this as the all-purpose term for a contractor who takes responsibility for construction and hires workers.

examples.english: This contractor is responsible for building the new school.
examples.traditional: 呢間承建商負責起新校舍。
examples.jyutping: ne1 gaan1 sing4 gin3 soeng1 fu6 zaak3 hei2 san1 haau6 se3

examples.english: This company is the builder for this project.
examples.traditional: 呢間公司係今次工程嘅承建商。
examples.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 hai6 gam1 ci3 gung1 cing4 ge3 sing4 gin3 soeng1
